sources.name: Kpler; UN Global Platform; IMF PortWatch
NOAA Office for Coastal Management / MarineCadastre

units.queue_stock: observed queue-candidate count, null when coverage is insufficient
units.friction: robust standardized index, not hours or TEUs

transformation_notes: Geospatial CSVs are daily aggregates, sensitivity summaries, or measurement-correction comparisons. Raw tracks, vessel identifiers and private trace keys are excluded. January pilot sensitivities remain labeled with their actual source_days; full-year acquisition does not turn them into full-year sensitivities.
reproduction_scope: Portable script replays 720 published forecast records and 30 metric rows, not source reacquisition or model refitting.
publication_scope: GitHub research repository only; no portfolio website publication.
release_note: Derived from the reviewed source bundle; publication documentation and repository hygiene added. Historical package code and numerical evidence are unchanged.
